label: the subject pronoun paradigm as a whole, including ham and the plural third person
note: ham and ve are introduced by chapter 94, completing the subject paradigm beside the main and vah the track already had. The note named the item that needed it -- mock 2 reading item 10, ham station par milenge -- and the synthesis lesson reads that sentence. The ham lesson also carries the use an English speaker does not expect: ham often stands in for main, said modestly or as part of a household, which is the same instinct that makes hamaara parivaar the natural way to say my family.
